Prep time: 5 minutes Cook time: 0 minutes Total time: 5 miutes Number of Servings: 1 Ingredients 2/3 cup low-fat vanilla yogurt or 1 container (6 ounces) 1/4 cup canned pumpkin 2 teaspoons brown sugar 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon 1/8 teaspoon nutmeg (optional) Directions Combine all ingredients in a bowl or blender. Mix until smooth and serve. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours. Notes: Top with granola or nugget type cereal for extra crunch. Extra canned pumpkin can be frozen to use later in main dishes, soups, chili or baked goods. Tastes great as a dip with cut fruit or graham crackers.
